caption:
Most "dead" leads in your CRM aren't dead.

Research on sales pipelines keeps finding the same thing: a lead who isn't ready today often buys later, if someone keeps showing up. Benchmark studies on lead nurturing put the gap at roughly 50% more sales-ready opportunities and 33% lower cost per close versus leads left alone after the first no answer.

Most shops never collect on this because the CRM tags a lead "lost" after one quiet call.

Build a four-touch ladder instead: a day-2 check-in, a day-7 value text, a day-30 offer, a day-90 final ask. Full example scripts in the carousel.

See it run on your own list, free.
